name: blog-writer
author: Spixed
description: A WYSIWYG editor for Hugo blogs (polymer theme), with split-render and bilingual modes.

scripts.electron:prepare: bun run fonts:fetch && bun run electron:fetch-hugo
scripts.electron:dev: bun run build && bun run electron:build-server && electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.electron:dist: bun run electron:prepare && bun run build && bun run electron:build-server && electron-builder --config electron/electron-builder.yml
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @blog-writer/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @blog-writer/server-node typecheck && bun run --filter @blog-writer/frontend typecheck
